name: New Buyer Pipeline
summary: Intake through closing for a buyer you are representing.

tasks.label: Add Buyer Name & Budget
tasks.hint: The name that goes on the paperwork, and the range they are shopping in.

tasks.label: Add Target Neighborhoods
tasks.hint: Where they want to look. Separate areas with commas.

tasks.label: Log the intro call
tasks.hint: Tick this once you have walked them through the process end to end.

tasks.label: Upload Signed Agency Disclosure
tasks.hint: Required before you show a single property. Must come back signed.

tasks.label: Upload Buyer Representation Agreement
tasks.hint: Sets your commission and the term. Must come back signed.

tasks.label: Upload Pre-Approval Letter
tasks.hint: Sellers will ask for this with every offer. Check the expiry date.

tasks.label: Add Lender Contact
tasks.hint: Who to call when an offer needs a proof-of-funds letter fast.

tasks.label: Upload Signed Purchase Agreement
tasks.hint: The accepted offer, with every addendum attached.

tasks.label: Upload Closing Disclosure
tasks.hint: Compare it against the estimate before the signing appointment.
